title: Vampire Vape Tropical Kiwi Cooler Flavour Concentrate 30ml
description: Kiwi Cooler Flavour Concentrate from Vampire Vape’s Tropical collection offers a bright citrus profile with Golden Kiwi and Tangelo, supported by a subtle cooling finish. The Golden Kiwi brings soft, tropical sweetness, while Tangelo cuts through with juicy citrus notes and a floral tartness. A hint of chill adds a crisp exhale that complements the fruit without overpowering it. This 30ml concentrate is designed for DIY e-liquid mixing and must be diluted before use. Ideal for vapers looking to customise their own VG/PG ratios and nicotine strengths. Vampire Vape concentrates are trusted by DIY mixers for their flavour consistency and quality. The Tropical range brings a modern fruit-focused twist to any blend. Also available in Nic Salt, Freebase and Shortfill formats.
